documentation.content: More than 2% of requests to SERVICE_NAME returned 5xx for 5 minutes. Check the 'llm call failed' and 'feedback failed' logs: if every model in a chain is failing, a vendor is down or a key has expired. Runbook: README > Operations.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name = "SERVICE_NAME" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code_class = "5xx"
